learning_objective: 🦠 Explore Whittaker's 5-Kingdom system and dive into the microscopic worlds of bacteria, protists, fungi, and mysterious viruses!

key_vocabulary.hindi_meaning: प्रोकैरियोट (ऐसी कोशिका जिसमें स्पष्ट केंद्रक नहीं होता)
यूकैरियोट (ऐसी कोशिका जिसमें स्पष्ट केंद्रक और कोशिकांग होते हैं)
माइकोप्लाज्मा (सबसे छोटी जीवित कोशिका, जिसमें कोशिका भित्ति नहीं होती)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: R.H. Whittaker (1969) proposed a 5-kingdom system: Monera, Protista, Fungi, Plantae, and Animalia. It is based on cell structure, body organization, mode of nutrition, reproduction, and evolutionary relationships.

Consists exclusively of bacteria (prokaryotes). They are the most abundant microorganisms. Examples include Archaebacteria (live in extreme, harsh habitats) and Eubacteria (true bacteria, like cyanobacteria which do photosynthesis).

The 'junk drawer' of biology! It includes all single-celled eukaryotes. They usually live in water. Examples include Chrysophytes (diatoms), Dinoflagellates, Euglenoids, Slime moulds, and Protozoans (like Amoeba and Paramecium).

Multicellular eukaryotes that are heterotrophic (absorb food from outside). Their cell walls are made of tough Chitin. They include yeast (unicellular exception), molds, and mushrooms. They form a vast network of threads called mycelium.

These are not included in the 5-kingdom system because they are not truly 'living' cells. Viruses have a protein coat and genetic material (DNA or RNA). Viroids are just free infectious RNA (causes potato spindle tuber disease). Prions are infectious folded proteins.

fun_activity.title: 👾 The Zombie Hijackers
fun_activity.instructions: Viruses are like zombies! Outside a host cell, they are completely inactive and crystal-like. But once they enter a living cell, they hijack the cell's machinery to make thousands of copies of themselves, eventually bursting the cell open!

exam_tips: 📌 Diatoms (Chrysophytes) have indestructible cell walls embedded with silica. The accumulation of these walls over billions of years forms 'Diatomaceous earth'.
📌 Methanogens (a type of archaebacteria) are present in the guts of cows and buffaloes and are responsible for producing methane (biogas) from their dung.
📌 Lichens are excellent pollution indicators—they do not grow in polluted areas (especially areas with high SO2).
quick_recap: ⭐ Mycoplasmas are the smallest known living cells and can survive without oxygen.
⭐ Fungi are cosmopolitan and grow best in warm and humid places.
⭐ W.M. Stanley showed that viruses could be crystallized.
